theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (S : Set (Rn N)) (w : Rn N → ℝ) (C : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet S μHE[n] → μHE[n] S < ∞ → IntegrableOn w S μHE[n] → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μHE[n] (S ∩ Metric.closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Rn N)), x ∈ S → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in S ∩ Metric.ball x ρ, |w z - w x| ∂μHE[n]) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
